messages:
amal: Quick heads-up — saw a sharp drop (~25%) in KV prefix reuse for tenant X after the 3/10 runtime change. Root cause looks like session handoffs zeroing fingerprints.
amal: Seen in profiler: `kv.lookup(prefix_fingerprint=0x9af3, session_id=...) -> MISS` lines repeated as context length grows.
amal: snippet:
```
2026-03-10T14:12:33Z INFO kv: key=pf_9af3 sess=abcd ttl=0 evicted_by=compactor
2026-03-10T14:12:33Z INFO compactor: freed 128MB
```
amal: hypothesis: new compaction + kernel scheduling (larger batches) increases on-GPU memory pressure so compactor is evicting prefetched prefixes that would have been reused across the session handoff handshake.
rajeev: I dug into profiler — compactor irt pageflip runs at ~120ms windows now, previously 40ms. that aligns with TTLs we set at 30s; eviction frequency increased. also we changed batch packing so long ctx gets grouped with short ones -> more peaked kv footprint.
kevin: can we be explicit in the handshake? when a request is routed to a different worker we zero the session fingerprint today. propose keeping a transient 'handoff_token' and try a soft-lookup before zeroing.
marie: +1. small patch idea:
```
# on handoff
if handshake.handoff_token:
   kt = decode(token)
   kv.soft_probe(kt, allow_stale=True)
else:
   zero_fingerprint()
```
sophia: Also saw kernel selection change — larger token batches choose a different attention kernel that spikes memory per-layer. That explains compaction windows triggering earlier.
sophia: quick mitigation: reduce micro-batch cap from 32->16 for the canary to lower transient memory, see if reuse ratio improves.
ci-bot: Created perf ticket PERF-4821: https://redwood/issue/PERF-4821 — will capture metrics/alerts for kv.reuse.prefix_hit_ratio and kv.compaction.run_ms
amal: plan: 1) enable soft handoff token (kevin) 2) lower micro-batch cap on canary (sophia) 3) bump prefix TTL from 30s->60s (marie) 4) add metric kv.reuse.prefix_hit_ratio (ci-bot)
amal: rolling canary to 10% traffic in us-west-2 tomorrow. will post perf graphs after 2 hours. :thumbsup:
